lines.rom: arati kijai srinatavara ji ki govardhana dhara bansidhara ki
nanda suvana jasumatike lala godhana gopi priya gopala devapriya asuranake kala mohana visvavimohana vara ki
jaya vasudeva devaki nandana kalayavana kansadi nikandana jagadadhara ajaya jagavandana nitya navina parama sundara ki
akala kaladhara sakala visvadhara visvambhara kamada karunakara ajara amara mayika mayahara nirguna cinmaya gunamandira ki
pandava puta pariksita raksaka atulita ahi agha musaka bhaksaka jagamaya jagata niriha niriksaka brahma paratpara paramesvara ki
nitya satya golokavihari ajavyakta lilavapudhari lilamaya lilavistari madhura manohara radhavara ki
